automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Leaf Update Watch

cutoff_window.rule: Include only public sources with direct visible publication or update dates inside the last 7 days relative to the run time; exclude missing, ambiguous, future-dated, crawl-only, snippet-only, or boundary-only dates.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot Business and Enterprise administrators can set optional expiration dates for individual user budgets. Expired individual budgets fall back to the next applicable cost-center or universal budget, and the Budgets REST API exposes an expires_at field.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Temporary spend overrides can now be treated as governed pilot, onboarding, incident-response, or role-change controls with explicit cleanup rather than manual follow-up debt.
qualifying_updates.federation_routing: Broad product and pricing details are upstream-owned; keep the downstream implication about temporary budget ownership, expiry, and workflow outcome evidence.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider adding a future ingest note to keep temporary budget overrides tied to owner, reason, model route, expiry, and accepted outcome.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot code review now includes approval assessments and can be authorized to submit pull-request approvals in public preview. The feature is off by default, configurable at enterprise, organization, and repository levels, and fresh commits dismiss Copilot approvals like human approvals.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: AI review output can now become merge-rule evidence when explicitly enabled, so local review gates should distinguish advisory assessments from authorized approvals that affect mergeability.
qualifying_updates.federation_routing: Product feature coverage belongs upstream; local coverage should focus on code-review authority, approval boundaries, and product judgment gates.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest should separate at-a-glance AI approval assessments from merge-counting approvals and require admin-scope evidence before treating them as release gates.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot enterprise-managed settings can set any preferred Copilot model as the default for new conversations, and can customize defaults by enterprise team through managed configuration files.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Model defaults become durable operating instructions that can vary by team, so request packages and telemetry should record which managed default shaped cost, behavior, and validation expectations.
qualifying_updates.federation_routing: Keep model and product catalog context upstream; downstream note should cover durable policy files, team defaults, and cost or eval attribution.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: If ingested, tie managed model defaults to skill/instruction ownership and workflow-level telemetry rather than duplicating model catalog details.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced Claude Fable 5.1 availability in Copilot with a policy that is off by default for Business and Enterprise. GitHub says this model requires data retention by default for Anthropic safety classifiers, with time-bound zero-data-retention access available only to eligible enterprise customers.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Model enablement is also a data-control and approval decision; local governance should require retention, eligibility, policy owner, and exception-expiry evidence before routing sensitive workflows to the model.
qualifying_updates.federation_routing: Broad model capabilities are upstream-owned; downstream coverage should focus on data retention, enablement authority, and sensitive-workflow routing.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Potential ingest should update sensitive-data and approval-boundary pages with model-policy and retention-gate implications.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI said Astra meets its Critical cybersecurity capability threshold and described stronger safeguards, additional monitoring, and production misalignment monitors that can slow, pause, or stop legitimate work. If a task pauses in ChatGPT or Codex, users may be asked to review; API tasks stop.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: High-capability agent runs need durable authorization, trace, pause, resume, and calibration evidence because safety monitors can interrupt long-running or defensive workflows as part of the execution boundary.
qualifying_updates.federation_routing: Keep model/system-card background upstream; local practice implication is execution-edge authorization, observability, and representative workflow calibration.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest should emphasize designed pause states and trace evidence for long-running agent workflows rather than model capability cataloging.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: IdeaBosque described five workflow-level patterns for multi-step agents: parallel read fan-out with serialized writes, human checkpoints as durable states, compensation paths, durable workflow state over stateless protocols, and measured data-driven branching.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This reinforces the local rule that approval and recovery boundaries should be persisted as workflow state and audit evidence, not left as prompt-only instructions in a chat session.
qualifying_updates.federation_routing: MCP protocol details are upstream-owned; downstream value is the workflow-state and approval-boundary practice.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Potential ingest can cross-link approval boundaries, context request packages, and shared-channel sessions around durable workflow state.
